--- new file: gradebook/statistics.py ---
+"""Statistics helpers for gradebook."""
+
+
+def median(values):
+    """Return the median of *values*.
+
+    For odd-length inputs, returns the middle value after sorting.
+    For even-length inputs, returns the mean of the two middle values.
+    Raises ValueError for empty input.
+    """
+    if values is None:
+        raise ValueError("median requires at least one value")
+    sorted_values = sorted(values)
+    n = len(sorted_values)
+    if n == 0:
+        raise ValueError("median requires at least one value")
+    mid = n // 2
+    if n % 2 == 1:
+        return sorted_values[mid]
+    return (sorted_values[mid - 1] + sorted_values[mid]) / 2
+
+
+def mean(values):
+    """Return the arithmetic mean of *values*."""
+    values = list(values)
+    if not values:
+        raise ValueError("mean requires at least one value")
+    return sum(values) / len(values)
+
+
+__all__ = ["median", "mean"]

--- new file: tests/test_statistics_regression.py ---
+"""Regression tests for median() with even-length inputs."""
+
+import unittest
+
+from gradebook.statistics import median
+
+
+class TestMedianEvenLengthRegression(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_even_length_returns_mean_of_two_middle_values(self):
+        self.assertEqual(median([1, 2, 3, 4]), 2.5)
+
+    def test_even_length_two_values(self):
+        self.assertEqual(median([1, 3]), 2.0)
+
+    def test_even_length_unsorted_input(self):
+        self.assertEqual(median([4, 1, 3, 2]), 2.5)
+
+    def test_even_length_not_upper_middle(self):
+        # Regression: previously returned upper middle (3) instead of 2.5
+        self.assertNotEqual(median([1, 2, 3, 4]), 3)
+        self.assertEqual(median([10, 20, 30, 40]), 25.0)
+        self.assertEqual(median([5, 5, 5, 5]), 5.0)
+
+    def test_odd_length_still_returns_middle_value(self):
+        self.assertEqual(median([1, 2, 3]), 2)
+        self.assertEqual(median([3, 1, 2]), 2)
+        self.assertEqual(median([42]), 42)
+
+    def test_empty_raises_value_error(self):
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+            median([])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
